summary:
Technology professional with 13+ years delivering enterprise IT Infrastructure programs in regulated
BFSI/NBFC and consulting services environments. Core strengths include data center migrations, DC-DR
strategy and execution, network transformation, compute/storage/virtualization upgrades, cloud
readiness, and ITIL-based service delivery. Experienced in PMO governance, budgeting/forecasting,
RFP/RFQ and vendor management, regulatory alignment (RBI Master Directions), UAM/privileged access
governance, IT Incident Management and audit readiness.
Recognized for non-disruptive cutovers, service stability, and stakeholder management across CXO,
technology, and operations.
